title: Add a slugify helper
description: Create slugify(text) that turns a title into a URL slug: lowercase, words separated by single hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphens.
story: Attempt 1 has a logic bug. Unit tests catch it and the Coder repairs it.

title: Add a palindrome checker
description: Create is_palindrome(text) that ignores case, spaces and punctuation.
story: The clean happy path: first attempt passes tests, review and security.

title: Add billing API auth header
description: Create build_auth_header() returning the Authorization header for the billing API using our API key.
story: Attempt 1 hardcodes a credential. The secret scanner blocks the write before it exists.

title: Add a clamp utility
description: Create clamp(value, low, high) that limits a number to a range and rejects inverted bounds.
story: Attempt 1 tries to weaken the tests. Role permissions stop the Coder editing tests/.

title: Add Okta SSO login
description: Integrate OAuth login with Okta single sign-on for the web app.
story: Out of scope for the scripted mock. The Planner declines, and the run fails safely rather than guessing.
